hypothesis: Meaningful Form 4 open-market purchase event-days may explain or identify high-value skipped A/B candidates from the entry-skip oracle.

parameters.candidate_scope: top_skipped_opportunities from entry_skip_oracle, 15 per canonical window

decision_rationale: No saved top skipped opportunity across the three canonical windows had a prior same-ticker meaningful Form 4 event even with a 120-calendar-day lookback. Form 4 therefore does not explain the known high-value skipped-candidate oracle set and should not be promoted as a scarce-slot replacement signal from this evidence.
next_action: Stop trying to use Form 4 as a near-term A/B slot-replacement overlay unless a materially broader Form 4 sample or different universe supplies new overlap evidence. If continuing the Form 4 line, treat it as a standalone external-event watchlist source and require separate multi-window forward evidence.
